crossRefs.note: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
“Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.
They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They…
Yahweh has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.
Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

translations.web: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
translations.bsb: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
translations.kjv: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
translations.asv: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;
